neighbours.label: A symbol token (= : => -- + - * , #) that comes right after a run of padding spaces, on the 2nd or later line of a block where several lines each have a name, padding spaces, then that symbol (aligned or ragged: 'width      = 3' / 'Date        : May'). Quiet for a single padded line, padding inside prose, a word (not a symbol) after the padding ('Name:      Ana'), '|' pipes, and weak (~0.2) for the same list with no padding ('x = 1').
neighbours.short: symbol after padding spaces, line after line
